review_text_raw:
I really want to like it but there are just some huge problems with the game. It didn't seem to register all of my keystrokes so I would constantly be typing in bad commands. You can press up just like in a shell but you can't arrow over to fix mistakes meaning if the mistake was in the beginning, you might as well just rewrite everything. Adding on to this, copying down ip addresses is such a huge part of the game you'd think there would be some sort of copy paste or click to run action but no, you have to make sure you copy it over exactly and do this multiple times per chapter. 

There's also no pause button and some are timer-based or just keep going through cut-scenes which means if you want to actually see what's happening, your only option is to restart the entire chapter. 

The game seems interesting enough but there's no real choices to be made. Even choosing different sentences means nothing overall. Plus you need to have specific people and files even if others worked better. This meant I basically relied on the walkthroughs as you either got it or didn't but wouldn't know either way. 

It's ok if you're there for the story, but the story didn't make much sense to me either so I just don't really have any reason to recommend it unfortunately.
